text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
My skin's barrier function is deteriorating...
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be a lack of protein...?
Not enough soy in my diet...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to eat her favorite foods due to her busy schedule,
Neo Universe ended up suffering from rough skin...
